title: Repeated-measures treatment comparison

gates.name: n explicit and unit-defined
gates.evidence: unit `subject` declared (36 rows -> 12 units, structure: clustered); the primary analysis runs at the `unit` level and the row-level results are kept as a labelled secondary; n=12.

gates.name: missing data mechanism declared
gates.evidence: no variable carries missing values (n=36 analysed).

gates.name: effect size accompanies p
gates.evidence: all 1 estimable tests carry an effect size with a 95% CI.

gates.name: uncertainty visible
gates.evidence: every descriptive statistic carries an SE, every comparison figure states its interval, and every prose p value sits beside a CI.

gates.name: multiple comparisons corrected
gates.evidence: only 1 test was estimable, so there is no family to correct.

gates.name: sensitivity tested
gates.evidence: 3 perturbation(s) ran across 1 outcome(s) (leave-one-group-out, block jackknife, extreme-value fence, strict complete cases) and every one agreed with the primary verdict at alpha=0.05. Appendix A1 reports them.

gates.name: no association-to-mechanism upgrade
gates.evidence: no forbidden construction appears outside a disclaimer (11 patterns checked across 253 lines).

gates.name: unknowns flagged
gates.evidence: every unknown the pipeline detected is written AUTHOR_INPUT_NEEDED and repeated in Appendix B (no unknowns detected).

structural.detail: all 1 figure(s) carry title, caption and a three-part body
0 forbidden phrases in the writer's own scan
